newsitem.title: USA: Northeast Utilities gets credit package.
newsitem.headline: Northeast Utilities gets credit package.

text.p: Northeast Utilities said on Friday that it has closed on a new three-year $314 million revolving credit agreement with a consortium of 12 banks.
The company said that up to $314 million is available to its largest operating unit, Connecticut Light and Power Co.
Northeast said it and Western Massachusetts Electric Co, another of its subsidiaries, can borrow up to $150 million each, but the overall limit for all borrowers remains at $314 million.
The agreement expires in November 1999, it said.
